case_title: THE PEOPLE OF THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA VS. INTERNATIONAL FIDELITY INSURANCE COMPANY

docket_entries.description: SUMMARY JUDGMENT FILED BY PLAINTIFF THE PEOPLE OF THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA AS TO DEFENDANT INTERNATIONAL FIDELITY INSURANCE COMPANY JUDICIAL COUNCIL CIVIL CASE COVER SHEET FILED
